cues.zh: 再看看康涅狄格州的纽黑文。

cues.zh: 再看看密歇根州的底特律。

cues.zh: 他们的建筑少得可怜，停车场却多得要命，而且大部分停车位都没在使用。

cues.en: A huge amount of this comes down to one municipal policy,
cues.zh: 这其中很大一部分归结于一项市政政策，

cues.en: parking minimums.
cues.zh: 停车位下限。

cues.en: That is policies which ensure that all new construction comes with a minimum amount of parking depending on the use of the building. Now I'm going to try and condense what Donald Shoop said in the high cost of free parking
cues.zh: 也就是确保所有新建建筑都根据建筑用途配备最低数量停车位的政策。现在我要试着把唐纳德·舒普在《免费停车的高昂代价》中所说的

cues.en: into less than five minutes.
cues.zh: 浓缩到五分钟以内。

cues.en: If you want a more thorough explanation,
cues.zh: 如果你想要更详尽的解释，

cues.en: I suggest you read the book. Now parking, especially free parking,
cues.zh: 我建议你去读那本书。现在说停车，尤其是免费停车，

cues.en: is an inefficient land use.
cues.zh: 是一种低效的土地利用方式。

cues.en: It produces little to no income,
cues.zh: 它几乎不产生任何收入，

cues.en: it takes up a huge amount of space,
cues.zh: 却占用大量空间，

cues.en: it is an impervious surface which increases storm water runoff,
cues.zh: 它是不透水表面，会增加雨水径流，

cues.en: It produces very little tax revenue
cues.zh: 它产生的税收极少，

cues.en: and it serves a limited number of people,
cues.zh: 而且它只服务于有限的人群，

cues.en: namely those who felt the need to drag one and a half tons of metal and rubber with them on the way to their destination.
cues.zh: 也就是那些觉得有必要在前往目的地途中拖着一吨半金属和橡胶的人。

cues.en: Now parking regulations go back to 1928
cues.zh: 停车法规可以追溯到1928年

cues.en: with the first metered street parking.
cues.zh: 那时出现了最早的计时路边停车。

cues.en: Parking minimums are a form of parking regulation whereby a certain amount of parking is required
cues.zh: 最低停车位要求是一种停车法规，规定必须提供一定数量的停车位

cues.en: according to the use of a building.
cues.zh: 具体取决于建筑的用途。

cues.en: A movie theater has a different parking requirement to a funeral home, which has a different parking requirement to a factory and so on.
cues.zh: 电影院和殡仪馆的停车要求不同，殡仪馆和工厂的停车要求也不同，以此类推。

cues.en: Municipalities
cues.zh: 市政当局

cues.en: may require say one parking spot per office worker or one parking spot per x square feet office space
cues.zh: 可能会要求每名办公人员一个停车位，或者每X平方英尺办公空间一个停车位

cues.en: or one and a half parking spots per residential bedroom
cues.zh: 或者每间住宅卧室一点五个停车位

cues.en: or two parking spots per hospital bed or five parking spots per bowling alley lane or whatever. There's not a lot of consistency between codes
cues.zh: 或者每张医院病床两个停车位，或者每条保龄球道五个停车位，诸如此类。各种法规之间并不太一致

cues.en: other than what municipalities
cues.zh: 除了市政当局

cues.en: have copied from other municipal codes
cues.zh: 从其他市政法规中照搬的内容

cues.en: rather than running their own parking studies. These parking minimums are typically extremely generous.
cues.zh: 而不是自己开展停车研究。这些最低停车位要求通常极其宽松。

cues.en: For instance, the luxury condo from before had 18 spaces between six condos,
cues.zh: 例如，之前的豪华公寓项目在六套公寓之间设了18个车位，

cues.en: which assumes two cars per condo
cues.zh: 相当于每套公寓两辆车

cues.en: plus space for a guest to park their car.
cues.zh: 外加供访客停车的空间。

cues.en: This is not far off from real regulations,
cues.zh: 这与实际法规相差不远，

cues.en: especially in car dependent cities like Los Angeles.
cues.zh: 尤其是在洛杉矶这样依赖汽车的城市。

cues.en: Parking is usually regulated for the worst case scenario
cues.zh: 停车位通常按最坏情况来规定

cues.en: and then some. Take a look at hashtag Black Friday parking on the Twitter to see how generous these regulations are to parkers.
cues.zh: 甚至更夸张。去Twitter上看看#BlackFridayParking标签，就能知道这些法规对停车者有多宽松。

cues.en: One result of parking minimums is a huge increase in the cost of new construction,
cues.zh: 最低停车位要求的一个后果是新建成本大幅增加，

cues.en: since all new buildings have to provide minimum parking.
cues.zh: 因为所有新建筑都必须提供最低数量的停车位。

cues.en: This has resulted in huge parking podiums and skyscrapers,
cues.zh: 这导致了巨大的停车平台和高层建筑，

cues.en: while developments farther out need to acquire much more land for parking to comply with the code.
cues.zh: 而更远地区的开发项目则需要获取更多土地用于停车，以符合法规要求。

cues.en: In many cities, even rehabs required parking if the use was changed.
cues.zh: 在许多城市，即使是翻新项目，如果用途发生变更，也需要配建停车位。

cues.en: A conversion from a warehouse
cues.zh: 从仓库

cues.en: to residential use required providing the parking for new residential construction.
cues.zh: 转为住宅用途，就需要为新的住宅建设提供停车位。

cues.en: So renovations had to be paired with large scale demolition of the adjacent urban fabric
cues.zh: 因此，翻新项目不得不与相邻城市肌理的大规模拆除相伴进行，

cues.en: or they just didn't happen at all.
cues.zh: 否则就根本无法实施。

cues.en: In many cities today, parking is the governing cost in any new construction,
cues.zh: 如今在许多城市，停车是任何新建项目中占主导地位的成本因素，

cues.en: especially construction on a large scale.
cues.zh: 尤其是大规模建设。

cues.en: The height of a skyscraper
cues.zh: 摩天大楼的高度

cues.en: is likely determined by the size and feasibility of the parking garage that can fit on the lot.
cues.zh: 很可能取决于地块上能容纳的停车库的规模和可行性。

cues.en: In many cities, parking minimums have been lowered since their heyday in the sixties through the nineties,
cues.zh: 在许多城市，停车配建下限自上世纪六十年代至九十年代的鼎盛时期以来已有所降低，

cues.en: but very few have repealed them altogether.
cues.zh: 但极少有城市将其完全废除。

cues.en: Furthermore,
cues.zh: 此外，

cues.en: most parking which has been created through these regulations is private.
cues.zh: 通过这些法规产生的停车位大多是私有的。

cues.en: Off street parking is usually plentiful but expensive,
cues.zh: 路外停车通常充足但昂贵，

cues.en: while curbside parking is cheap and rare.
cues.zh: 而路边停车便宜且稀缺。

cues.en: This inversion of the usual price demand relationship
cues.zh: 这种对通常价格需求关系的颠倒

cues.en: leads to folks complaining about the lack of parking even in areas with abundant parking garages and off street parking,
cues.zh: 导致人们即使在停车库和路外停车位充裕的区域也抱怨停车位不足，

cues.en: which makes reducing parking minimums extremely difficult, politically speaking.
cues.zh: 这使得降低停车配建下限在政治上极为困难。

cues.en: Now, thankfully, many cities are taking steps today to lower parking minimums,
cues.zh: 好在如今许多城市正在采取措施降低停车配建下限，

cues.en: especially near heavy rail transit stations.
cues.zh: 尤其是在重轨 transit 车站附近。

cues.en: But so long as we insist on dragging one and a half tons of metal and plastic with us on most of our trips,
cues.zh: 但只要我们大多数出行还坚持拖着这一吨半的金属和塑料，

cues.en: the parking problem isn't going away anytime soon.
cues.zh: 停车问题短期内不会消失。

cues.en: Anyway,
cues.zh: 总之，

cues.en: thanks for watching my YouTube video about parking. I hope it gets you thinking about parking.
cues.zh: 感谢观看我这期关于停车的YouTube视频。希望它能让你思考停车问题。

cues.en: I hope it gets you thinking about how to improve your parking in city skylines,
cues.zh: 希望它能让你思考如何在《城市天际线》中改进停车，

cues.en: but hopefully how to improve it in real life too.
cues.zh: 但更希望也能让你思考如何在现实生活中改进停车。

cues.en: Please
cues.zh: 请

cues.en: go ahead and hit that subscribe button.
cues.zh: 继续点击订阅按钮。

cues.en: And I would like to thank my patreons
cues.zh: 我还要感谢我的Patreon赞助者们，

cues.en: who are appearing on the screen right now.
cues.zh: 他们现在正出现在屏幕上。

cues.en: Anyway, see you at the next video.
cues.zh: 总之，下期视频见。

cues.en: Bye.
cues.zh: 拜。
